title: Anything working for animations ?
author: Thedudixa
selftext:
Hey, I'm looking for a software that works for animating humanoids but maybe also more complexe creatures, like dragons ? 

I want to work with low poly synty style generated 3D models. 

Also if you have anything regarding the best software for that and retopology 🤘.

Thank you

comments.author: missEves
comments.body: you can try meshy for 3d models and animations

replies.author: Thedudixa
replies.body: I don't remember it having a custom animations maker? Is that the case?

comments.author: Roguelike-Engine103
comments.body: autosprite isn't bad, but has a problem I see across all these tools (even meshy) ... the size and framing of characters varies from animation to animation

replies.author: Thedudixa
replies.body: Hmmm, interesting I also tried important a 3D model to unreal and the size was very small I had to put the scale to 100 to see the character. Not sure if that was your point though. I guess AI isn't quite there yet but in 1 year / 6 month we might have some really good models

replies.author: Roguelike-Engine103
replies.body: No my point is the AI generations are inconsistently sized compared to the last thing it made

comments.author: op_app_pewer
comments.body:
I’ve wanted to try out hunyuan motion
Should work for humanoids in 3d, but haven’t tried^^

replies.author: Thedudixa
replies.body: Yeah I think it's really the only option here

comments.author: thelionskywalker
comments.body: Try out dreamforge.ai it has a free plan and you can do really good sprites and animations.
